what_this_measures: D-014's pattern re-run on the segment that actually ships: identity persistence with the dataset's calibrated geometry versus appearance-only fusion. Identical frames, identical detections, identical embedder; the only difference is whether geometry is allowed to speak. Gate evidence for G_D2.

segment.name: wildtrack-sparsest-40
segment.why: sparsest 40-frame window in WILDTRACK: mean 15.6 people/frame, min 13, max 19, every one of them visible in >=2 cameras. The dataset's floor over all 400 annotated frames is 13 people, so no sparser segment exists to pick.
